scope: Exploratory analysis implemented during generation, before viewing any new condition scores. Generation design frozen before inference; do not describe this as independent preregistered confirmation.
compliance_definition: nonempty contiguous normalized phrase from available sentence or a supplied field, without the target verb; operational format measure, not a complete grammatical NP judgment
semantic_limit: Referent alias scoring is AI-provisional; source-span EM remains separate. No independent human semantic validation.
non_eos_rule: Non-EOS budget/length terminations count as failed answers, regardless of a matching truncated span.
